The console is resting on a black surface, likely a couch or chair.
A watermark 'EASY GAMES & GADGETS' is visible across the center of the image.
The console appears to be in a clean, well-lit environment.
No power cable, HDMI cable, or other accessories are visible in the photo.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this clearly enough to read.
Photo 0 shows one white DualSense controller, which is the official DualSense for PlayStation 5.

claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: Console may not power on or may have internal damage
risks.proof: A video showing the console powering on, booting up, and displaying the PS5 home screen.

risks.risk: Controller may not function properly (e.g., no battery, dead buttons, or connectivity issues)
risks.proof: A video showing the controller connecting to the console and responding to button presses.

risks.risk: Console may be stolen or have a blacklisted serial number
risks.proof: A clear photo of the serial number on the back of the console, and a verification check via PlayStation's official serial number lookup.

risks.risk: Missing accessories (power cable, HDMI cable, etc.)
risks.proof: A photo showing all included accessories laid out next to the console.

proof_requests: Video of the console powering on and booting up.
Video of the controller connecting and functioning.
Photo of the serial number on the back of the console.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
